g.text: Book Table 4.5 · Equal-weight least squares in log correlations · Same axes

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536271

g.text: Left: three free coefficients. Right: directly fitted in r and m, with h² = m/r.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536271

g.text: Only the equality constraint is imposed; no upper bounds. The right-hand fit implies r > 1 for six outcomes.
